original.statement: RBAC roles created by XRDs no longer receive labels identifying which XRD created them.

decision.reason: [ev-9f092216dc42] only says that RBAC roles are no longer labelled with the XRD that created them. That changes metadata on generated roles; nothing in it says any permission is granted, needed or lost. The proposed rbac-permission subject is also malformed: "roles-xrd-labels" is not a resource/verb name, and the "rbac" component is not named in the evidence. The evidence does not give the label key or a component that owns it, so no subject in any family can be built from it. PR #6521 would be needed to state this change correctly.
